name: Conditional Visibility Wrapper
description: Wraps chld content and suppresses it based on appendprops.xsUp, evaluated with the binding-expression DSL (see expressions/binding-expression-dsl.md). Used for page-mode-based visibility, feature flags, and empty-state handling.

appendprops.xsUp.description: true/false to hard-code, or a bracketed expression like "[dsPagemode.pagemode(eq)raw.view]". When the expression evaluates truthy, the wrapped chld is SUPPRESSED (xsUp historically meant 'suppress' in this engine's convention, confirmed by usage: dsPagemode.pagemode(eq)raw.view hides edit-only fields while viewing).
